name: tendboat
description: Cross-language taint analysis as a plugin: tendboat holds the whole-repo index, the contract knowledge base and the solver; your agent supplies the judgement.

plugins.name: tendboat
plugins.description: Taint-analyse a polyglot repository. tendboat remembers the parts of the repo your agent is not looking at: every function, call, HTTP route and deploy hop, indexed deterministically, plus a solver that composes it to a fixpoint. Finds injection, secret-leak, path-traversal, SSRF, deserialization and missing-authorization defects that cross a file, a language or a process boundary. No model of its own -- your agent is the only one.
